title: 第266章 血毒的来历第265章 突破
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
当李幽若镇北王府，来到叶凡住处的时候。
小白虎早已结束战斗，李幽若看着满地狼藉，叶凡已经睡去。
“可恶，被谁捷足先登了？”
“难道是沈慕戎？整个龙都谁不知道，叶峥嵘的那九个小老婆，跟他一点关系都没有，他碰都没有碰一下！沈慕戎和叶凡，也没有血缘关系。”
“若是为了救人，可能就是沈慕戎！”
李幽若分析。
旋即。
眉头又一皱：“不对，沈慕戎在闭关，已经大半个月没出关，不可能是她。”
“难道是纳兰雪嫣？可恶！”
“纳兰风云这个老东西！早就算计好了一切！”
“我就说，他之前每天都蹲在镇北王府大门口，美其名曰等孙女，实际上就是在等叶凡！”
“这几天叶凡回来，纳兰风云这个臭不要脸的，甚至把纳兰家搬到镇北王府隔壁，可不就是想把纳兰嫣然送给叶凡吗？”李幽若分析的头头是道。
最终确定。
一定是纳兰雪嫣，帮叶凡解毒的！
“可恶！”
李幽若看着熟睡的叶凡。
果断上前！
睡梦中，叶凡感受到一阵温暖。
……
次日一早，李幽若离去，叶凡生龙活虎。

纳兰风云早就等候在演武场，见到叶凡走过来，疑惑的问道：“叶小子，昨天你脸色不对劲就跑了，说什么有毒？”
“这是怎么回事？难道你中毒了？”
叶凡没有隐瞒。
将自己被下毒，剧毒早已深入血脉的事，说了一遍。
并且这种毒很特殊，一旦他每次武道突破，都会让他毒发。
纳兰风云惊讶：“这么说，你从小时候开始，就有人对你下毒了？”
“是。”
叶凡点头。
“找出来是谁没有？”
叶凡摇了摇头。
纳兰风云伸出一只手，扣住叶凡的手腕，一股内力注入其中，在他的体内畅通无阻。
片刻之后，纳兰风云收回内力，老脸凝重。
content_en:
When Li Youruo came to Zhenbei Palace and came to Ye Fan's residence.
The little white tiger had already finished the battle, Li Youruo looked at the mess on the ground, and Ye Fan had already fallen asleep.
"Damn it, who got there first?"
"Is it Shen Murong? No one in the entire Long City knows that Ye Zhengrong's nine little wives have nothing to do with him, and he has never touched them! Shen Murong and Ye Fan are not related by blood."
"If it's to save someone, it might be Shen Murong!"
Li Youruo analyzed.
Immediately.
His brows furrowed again: "No, Shen Murong is in seclusion and has not been out of seclusion for more than half a month. It can't be her."
"Is it Nalan Xueyan? Damn it!"
"Nalan Fengyun, this old guy! He has already planned everything!"
"Let me just say that he used to squat at the gate of Zhenbei Prince's Mansion every day, euphemistically saying he was waiting for his granddaughter, but in fact he was waiting for Mark!"
"When Ye Fan comes back in the past few days, Nalan Fengyun is so shameless that he even moved Nalan's family next door to Zhenbei Palace. Isn't that just to give Nalan Yanran to Ye Fan?" Li Youruo analyzed clearly.
finalized.
It must be Nalan Xueyan who helped Ye Fan detoxify!
"Damn it!"
Li Youruo looked at Ye Fan who was sleeping soundly.
Step forward decisively!
In his sleep, Ye Fan felt a burst of warmth.
…
Early the next morning, Li Youruo left, and Ye Fan was alive and well.
Nalan Fengyun had been waiting at the martial arts arena for a long time. When he saw Ye Fan coming over, he asked doubtfully: "Boss Ye, you ran away yesterday with a bad look on your face. What did you say was poisonous?"
"What's going on? Are you poisoned?"
Ye Fan didn’t hide anything.
He said once that he had been poisoned and that the poison had already penetrated into his blood.
And this kind of poison is very special. Every time he makes a breakthrough in martial arts, it will cause him to be poisoned.
Nalan Fengyun was surprised: "So, someone has been poisoning you since you were a child?"
"Yes."
Ye Fan nodded.
"Have you found out who it is?"
Ye Fan shook his head.
Nalan Fengyun stretched out a hand and clasped Ye Fan's wrist, injecting an internal force into it and flowing freely through his body.
After a while, Nalan Fengyun withdrew his inner strength, his old face solemn.
